For trade buyers

B2B Supply for Foodservice Businesses

Foodservice businesses need bakery products they can rely on — consistent in quality, size and presentation, order after order. Plum's B2B range covers seven product families, with fresh and baked-frozen options in selected families. Browse the catalogue below, open any product for its specifications, and request a quote for the items and quantities you need.

Tell us what your business needs

Let the team know what type of business you run, which product families interest you, your estimated volumes and delivery location. This helps focus the next conversation.

  • Restaurants and food-service operators

B2B process

How to enquire about supply

  1. Select your products

    Identify the categories or specific product names relevant to your business.

  2. Share your requirements

    Include business type, city, estimated quantity and how often you may need delivery.

  3. Discuss the proposal

    Review actual formats, availability and commercial terms directly with the Plum team.

Buyer guide

B2B Frequently Asked Questions

Open any product and select "Request a Quote for This Product", or use the B2B quote form to list several products and your expected quantities.

Lead times vary by product and quantity and are confirmed when your supply arrangement is agreed.

Please include your delivery location in your request. Delivery coverage is confirmed during onboarding.

Storage guidance is specific to each product and will be shown on each product page once approved product documentation is supplied.
